title: 회생ㆍ파산위원회 설치 및 운영에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:6:0:00006:part:1/1
title_original: 회생ㆍ파산위원회 설치 및 운영에 관한 규칙
full_text:
Article 6 (Meetings)
(1) Meetings of the Committee shall be divided into regular meetings and extraordinary meetings, which shall be held as follows:
1. Regular meetings: Once every half-year;
2. Extraordinary meetings: Whenever the Chairperson deems necessary.
(2) A meeting shall open with a majority of the incumbent members present, and resolutions shall be adopted by the affirmative votes of a majority of the members present.
(3) Minor matters or matters requiring urgent action may be decided in writing as determined by the Chairperson.
(4) Meetings of the Committee shall not be open to the public: Provided, That the Committee may disclose all or part of meeting materials or proceedings by resolution.
(5) The head of the working-level support group shall prepare minutes summarizing the results of a meeting (or a record of resolution where a written resolution is adopted under paragraph (3)), and the Chairperson and standing member shall sign or affix their names and seals to the minutes. <Amended on September 6, 2016.>
